source: original (parallel to 7-7PreQuiz Q1, version A: ln 5+ln 6, 2 ln 3, -ln(1/4))

parts.label: a
parts.description: Express ln 5 + ln 6 in form ln k.
parts.notes: A1 for ln 30. Direct application of product rule ln a + ln b = ln(ab).

parts.label: b
parts.description: Express 2 ln 3 in form ln k.
parts.notes: A1 for ln 3^2 (intermediate, application of power rule). A1 for ln 9.

parts.label: c
parts.notes: A1 for an intermediate step such as ln(1/4)^(-1), -(ln 1 - ln 4), or -ln 4^(-1). A1 for ln 4.

source: original (parallel to 7-7PreQuiz Q2, version A: log_10 2 = p, log_10 5 = q)

parts.label: a
parts.description: Express log_10(40) in terms of p = log_10(2) and q = log_10(5).
parts.tolerance: Accept 3p + q. Argument 40 must be decomposed as 2^3 * 5.
parts.notes: M1 for correct application of product rule and/or power rule. A1 for an intermediate expression in log_10 2 and log_10 5 with arguments 2 and 5. A1 for 3p + q.

parts.label: b
parts.description: Express log_5(4) in terms of p = log_10(2) and q = log_10(5).
parts.notes: A1 for log_10(4)/log_10(5) or 2 log_10(2)/log_10(5) (change of base). A1 for 2p/q.

source: original (parallel to 7-7PreQuiz Q3, version A: log_10 a = 1/2)

parts.label: a
parts.notes: A1 for an intermediate form (log_10 1 - log_10 a, or log_10 a^(-1) = -log_10 a, or log_10 10^(-1/2)). A1 for -1/2.

parts.label: b
parts.notes: A1 for change of base log_100 a = log_10 a / log_10 100. A1 for substituting log_10 a = 1/2 and log_10 100 = 2 to get (1/2)/2. A1 for 1/4.

source: original (parallel to 7-7PreQuiz Q4, version A: solve 2 ln x = ln 25 + 6)

parts.description: Solve 2 ln x = ln 25 + 6. Give answer as x = p e^q with p, q in Z+.
parts.tolerance: Accept x = 5 e^3 or x = 5e^3 or (p, q) = (5, 3). Other equivalent forms (e.g. sqrt(25 e^6)) earn intermediate marks but the requested form is x = pe^q with p, q positive integers.
parts.notes: M1 for using m ln x = ln x^m to write ln x^2 = ln 25 + 6. M1 for using ln a - ln b = ln(a/b) to combine into a single logarithmic expression. A1 for x^2/25 = e^6 (or x^2 = 25 e^6). A1 for x = sqrt(25 e^6) = 5 e^3 (with x > 0 noted). A1 for stating p = 5, q = 3. Method 2 (express 6 as 6 ln e first) earns the same marks.
